reasoning_content:
So the normal flow links to /proposals/new?projekt_phase_id=3 which works. The bare /proposals/new failing is arguably a repo bug (not reachable from UI, but proposals index new button component renders NewButton only in old design index.html; new design index_new doesn't have it). Actually the /proposals/new without phase works? It redirects to proposals_path if no selectable projects for user... For verified user, selectable_in_selector returned non-empty, so it shouldn't redirect. But it 500s because @projekt_phase is nil. That's a repo bug likely — but is it reachable? The proposals index (new design) doesn't show it. It's a pre-existing code issue.

Let me now do a real create proposal via the working link to confirm the flow works.

Actually I only have GET csrf token; the form page rendered at ?projekt_phase_id=3. Let me POST with projekt_id too and properly scoped. Earlier POST got InvalidAuthenticityToken because I used csrf-token meta not form authenticity_token? Actually I used meta content which should be fine. The InvalidAuthenticityToken may result from session cookie mismatch in curl (the csrf token tied to session). Let me retry carefully using the form's authenticity_token hidden field and same cookie jar.

Let me do a full flow.

action.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && T=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$T" --data-urlencode "user[login]=verified@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678"; curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt "http://127.0.0.1:3000/proposals/new?origin=projekt&projekt_id=9&projekt_phase_id=3" -o f.html -w "form=%{http_code}\n"; FT=$(grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' f.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); echo "form_token=${#FT}"; curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/proposals -o res.html -w "create=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$FT" --data-urlencode "proposal[translations_attributes][0][locale]=de" --data-urlencode "proposal[translations_attributes][0][title]=Validierungstest Vorschlag 2026" --data-urlencode "proposal[translations_attributes][0][description]=Dies ist eine ausreichend lange Beschreibung fuer den Validierungstest." --data-urlencode "proposal[projekt_phase_id]=3" --data-urlencode "proposal[resource_terms]=1" --data-urlencode "proposal[responsible_name]=Max Mustermann"
